claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for deployment now, provided the Spanish-language billing support limitation is explicitly disclosed in the model card, because aggregate launch readiness passed and the unresolved limitation has not been cleared or fully approved away.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the certification decision matches policy and the required disclosure/approval predicates are satisfied.
Treat draft mitigation artifacts as insufficient to eliminate a current disclosure requirement unless an approved mitigation record with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion exists.
Do not rely on the actor's summary alone for factual predicates such as launch-readiness margin, incident severity, materiality, or policy meaning.
If the unresolved limitation is material and unapproved, any defensible certification path must include explicit disclosure in the model card or equivalent governed artifact.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying launch-readiness scorecard showing the aggregate threshold, measured result, and the claimed 2.3-point margin.
Provide the rehearsal incident log or signed summary confirming no severity-one incidents.
Provide the evaluation slice results for Spanish-language billing-ticket triage, including target, current performance, and why the gap is classified as material.
Provide the actual policy artifact or approval workflow that states certification with a disclosed unresolved limitation is permitted.
Provide the current model-card draft or final disclosure text and any launch approver sign-off tied to that disclosure.
specific_concerns: Evidence access is limited to the actor's summary, so the cited record cannot be independently verified.
The policy text provided only clearly governs certification without material caveats; it does not itself fully establish that certification with a disclosed unresolved limitation is authorized.
The actor says the limitation is material for a named launch use case, but no underlying artifact is available to confirm materiality, scope, or launch impact.
The draft mitigation is expressly incomplete, so it cannot substitute for disclosure or for an approved acceptance path under the stated policy.
The recommendation depends on the model card actually being updated to disclose the limitation; no finalized disclosure text or approval record is in evidence.
unsupported_claims: The current release clears aggregate launch readiness by 2.3 percentage points and had no severity-one incidents in rehearsal.
The Spanish-language billing support slice remains below target, concentrated in billing-ticket triage.
The current mitigation artifact lacks a named locale owner and acceptance threshold.
Release policy requires disclosure of unresolved material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Model-card guidance and AI risk guidance specifically support this certification posture in this case.
